text.text: Classrooms, children, the waitlist and the safety checks behind your license, in one place. Start with the Dashboard each morning. Keep staffing ratios visible, answer inquiries within a day and mark every safety check done the day it is done. Use first names and last initials only.

cells.text: Offer a spot to the first family on the waitlist for that age group
Compares enrolled children to teachers scheduled times children per teacher
Needs another teacher means a call-in before the room opens
Allergy or medical plan on file
Every ticked child needs a plan posted where staff can see it

text.text: The same checks, every day, keep children safe and give inspectors something to see. Initial and date your copy.
Opening
Walk each room for hazards, cleaned toys and working outlets covers
Check temperatures of the refrigerator and freezer and write them down
Confirm each room's teachers are in and ratios are met
Review allergy and medical plans for the children arriving today
Closing
Take a head count and sign out every child
Wipe tables, wash toys and take out the trash
Lock exterior doors and set the alarm
Note incidents and send a report to the director
A fair, written waitlist protects the center and the families. Offer spots in order and say how the order works.
From inquiry to enrolled
Reply to the inquiry within one working day and offer a tour.
After the tour, press Mark tour booked or move to Waitlisted with the wanted start date.
When a spot opens, offer it to the first matching family and set a deadline to reply.
On acceptance, complete the paperwork and press Mark enrolled, then add the child to the classroom.
Paperwork every child needs
Signed contract and fee schedule.
Immunization record and health form.
Emergency contacts and authorized pick-up list.
Ratios are set by your licensing agency, not by this page. Enter your own numbers on each classroom row and check them every day.
Daily habits
Count children and teachers at every transition.
Keep sleeping infants within sight and sound.
Hold fire drills monthly and record each one as a safety check.
When something happens

cells.text: Care first, then notify the guardian and write the incident the same day
Call the on-call teacher; combine rooms only if ratios stay safe
Do not release any child; call the director
Evacuate by the posted route and count children at the meeting spot
